profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer - Game Developer and Toolsmith
profile.summary:
Game Development Success is rooted in the strength of your vision and mediated by your team's ability to iterate and execute. GenAI is disrupting every part of GameDev, and I am fighting to save our industry from being buried under AI slop. Empowering creatives to materialize amazing experiences using the capabilities of emerging tech is existentially important today.

My values and experience will bring immediate contribution to any team shipping high-quality products, providing individual contributions alongside the leadership to deliver, all while sustainably growing as a creative and technical organization. I build teams and cultivate a culture around delivery and surprising our customers, be them developers, players-as-developers, or the players themselves.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Minecraft, foundational tech, more info to come!

positions.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
positions.description:
Multiple roles as Senior Software Engineer and Senior Technical Product Manager within Frostbite. Drove development of Editor and Content Framework technologies, including scalable content conditioning pipelines, live-service-aware content management systems, and workflow API that empowers game team engineers and technical artists to accelerate content creation workflows.

Strategic Product Leadership: Defined product vision and execution strategy for foundational tools and infrastructure used across EA Sports (FC, Madden, Skate) and EA Games (Dead Space, Dragon Age, Battlefield). Defined KPI and drove improvements resulting in an over 50% reduction in cook times for Battlefield and over $1M in cost savings per-year.

Content Layers Initiative: Led Frostbite to deliver Battlefield a scalable content management system for live service, significantly reducing the cost and complexity of data management. Aligned cross-domain engineering efforts to completely eliminate live-service content management integration costs for senior developers.

Frostbite API: Recovered and led an at-risk, high-impact initiative to enable game team-driven workflow scripting. Aligned multiple across engineering, technical art, and product efforts ensuring successful delivery. Delivered improvements instrumental in supporting content creation targets and monetization goals for Battlefield. Included IC work in C++ and python.

Frostbite Inspector: Took over program and product management for flagship editor feature mid-development. Orchestrated roadmap reset and guided incremental delivery for a multi-year, multi-team effort to ensure long-term adoption and technical success. Reduced related editor defects, including crashes, by 50%.  Included IC work in C# and WPF.

positions.title: Lead Tools Engineer
positions.description:
Directed strategy, architecture, and execution for all internal content creation tools and pipelines. Built and scaled the team responsible for empowering artists, designers, and engineers to deliver award-winning first-party Nintendo titles.

End-to-End Tooling Ownership: Led full-stack development and support of 15+ user-facing tools and systems supporting all stages of content creation, game logic, and asset workflows. Ensured stability for over 150 developers rapidly iterating across the engine and toolset. IC contributions in C# and C++ to tooling and workflows.

Systems Architecture: Acted as principal architect for tools and runtime technologies including implementation and migration to ECS (tooling and runtime), content management database and conditioning technologies, and tooling architecture standards (WFP, MVVM) during active development.

Product & Program Management: Oversaw roadmap planning, project execution, and feature delivery across multiple product cycles.

People Management: Recruited and led a multi-disciplinary engineering team, establishing best practices for sustainable tools development aligned with studio needs including code reviews and defect resolution.

Gameplay Development: Designed and implemented the UI reticule for WiiMote in Metroid Prime 3. Contributed to gameplay with AI implementations, including boss AI. Developed new UI framework using existing animation system and tooling allowing for non-engineer UI development. IC contributions in C++.

Shipped Products: Donkey Kong Country: Tropical Freeze (Switch), Donkey Kong Country: Tropical Freeze (WiiU), Donkey Kong Country Returns (Wii), Metroid Prime Trilogy (Wii), Metroid Prime 3: Corruption (Wii). Mario Kart 3DS (3DS)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Individual contribution as Software Engineer (Madden 2002/2003, NFL Street), Lead Technology Engineer (NFL Street 2), Lead Tools Engineer (Superman Returns), 

2-Minute Drill Game Mode: Full implementation of new “arcade” game mode for Madden, extending existing gameplay loop to accommodate new game flow and scoring.

Player Customization System: Extended Madden player rendering to support player expression and customization through a swappable part system. Contributions included database tooling, pipelines, and in-game content management including streaming.

Rendering: Implemented “Gamebreaker” rendering effect using custom PS2 microcode, ported feature to Xbox and GameCube.

Open-World Tooling: Established framework for ZOD open-world tooling for Superman Returns. Extended prototype content management technologies (GCMS) to support open-world content and scale. Collaborated with Technical Art to develop procedural city enabling environment to be developed at scale and quality required.

Shipped Products: Madden 2002, Madden 2003, NFL Street 1, NFL Street 2, Superman Returns, credited additional contributions on at least 3 other titles (PS2, Xbox, GameCube).
